DIAGNOSIS READY: Pneumonia.

The patient is a 30-year-old male with a one-week history of left-sided chest pain, productive cough with purulent sputum, and shortness of breath. He was recently diagnosed with influenza but did not adhere to the treatment plan. Given the purulent sputum and failure to improve with influenza management, I suspect a secondary bacterial pneumonia. I need to confirm this with imaging and labs.

REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC).
REQUEST TEST: Chest X-Ray.
REQUEST IMAGES.
